title: More Memory, Better Videos? A Controlled Study of Visual Memory in Long-Video Generation
title_zh: 更多记忆带来更好的视频？长视频生成中视觉记忆的受控研究

paragraphs.en: Long-video generators increasingly retrieve past visual observations to prevent identity drift. The intuition is compelling: more access to history should make future video more consistent. But an image can be faithful to the past and wrong for the present. Does visual memory always improve the generated story? We investigate this question through VMem-Bench , a two-track diagnostic study. Track-A measures which references are selected from 92 real films (16,548 segments), before generation and without generator confounds. Track-B compares four retrieval policies with no-memory and gold-informed last-seen controls on 30 causally generated stories (2,824 segments) using a shared generator. Retrieval increases entity recall from 0.559 to 0.628–0.693 and improves similarity to past appearances, but decreases precision from 0.977 to 0.915–0.938 and forbidden-entity avoidance from 0.968 to 0.845–0.898. It can also reinforce obsolete appearances after the story changes them. Conversely, high long-gap recall can arise without memory when the prompt itself supplies the appearance; an appearance-stripping analysis exposes this confound. These results distinguish historical fidelity from current-story correctness and show why retrieval relevance or final-video consistency alone does not establish memory utility.

Historical retrieval can restore visual context when a character returns [ 23 , 4 ] . Other systems compress frame or KV histories [ 26 , 7 ] , or organize memory by entity [ 8 , 2 ] . Memory-conditioned storytelling likewise uses earlier shots to anchor later appearances [ 25 , 17 ] . But the story may have changed: the character wears a new outfit, an object has been destroyed, or a deceased person is mentioned without being present. paragraphs.en: Beyond perceptual and cross-shot consistency measured by existing evaluations [ 6 , 20 , 3 ] : when does access to visual history actually help generation, and when does it introduce interference? Three confounds complicate this question. First , the current prompt may already describe a returning entity. Second , historical matching may preserve obsolete appearances; state tracking differs from identity anchoring [ 8 , 29 ] . Third , relevant references may contain now-forbidden entities. Retrieval evaluation separates relevance, downstream utility, and distracting evidence [ 14 ] . For visual generation, current-state correctness and entity exclusion must be measured alongside historical resemblance.

paragraphs.en: Track-A replays 92 real films, evaluating reference selection against frozen entity-level gold before the next segment is revealed. Track-B runs 30 authored stories causally, comparing four retrieval policies with no-memory and gold-informed last-seen controls under one video-generation pipeline. These matched-prompt comparisons evaluate complete policies : each policy writes its own history. They are not single-step interventions, and the two tracks use different instances.
paragraphs.zh: Track-A 重放 92 部真实影片，在下一片段揭示之前，针对冻结的实体级黄金标准评估参考选择。 Track-B 以因果方式运行 30 部人工创作的故事，在单一视频生成管线之下，将四种检索策略与无记忆及黄金标准提示的最近可见对照组进行比较。 这些匹配提示的比较评估的是完整策略：每种策略都会写入自己的历史。 它们不是单步干预，并且两条赛道使用不同的实例。

paragraphs.en: Within this controlled setting, retrieval improves overall entity recall and appearance similarity to historical renderings. Yet it also decreases precision and forbidden-entity avoidance; on changed-state returns it can restore an outdated appearance. Long-gap success partly reflects prompt information: no-memory generation can achieve high recall when instructions describe the entity. Memory utility therefore requires checking what history adds , which temporal state is valid , and what unwanted content it brings . These findings concern visual-history utility, not a memory-capacity scaling law.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一受控环境中，检索提升了整体实体召回率以及与历史渲染结果的外观相似度。 然而它也降低了精确度和禁用实体回避能力；在状态已发生变化的返回中，它可能恢复过时的外观。 长时间间隔的成功部分归因于提示信息：当指令描述了实体时，无记忆生成也能实现高召回率。 因此，记忆的效用需要核查历史增加了什么、哪个时间状态是有效的，以及它带来了哪些不需要的内容。 这些发现关注的是视觉历史的效用，而非记忆容量的规模定律。

paragraphs.en: A controlled characterization of memory’s trade-offs. We show, across four retrieval policies and two controls, that historical references increase recall and appearance continuity while also increasing unwanted appearances and sometimes conflicting with updated story states.

paragraphs.en: A reusable diagnostic study framework. VMem-Bench combines pre-generation evidence analysis (92 films, 16,548 segments, 2,803 entities) and post-generation, closed-loop evaluation (30 stories, 2,824 segments, nine memory stresses), with controlled retrieval comparisons, frozen scoring, and explicit limitations on attribution.

paragraphs.en: Visual histories support causal generation through compressed frame or KV context [ 26 , 7 , 22 ] , historical retrieval [ 23 , 4 , 28 ] , and entity-indexed state [ 8 , 2 , 29 ] . OneStory learns adaptive historical-frame conditioning [ 1 ] ; StoryMem learns memory-conditioned multi-shot generation [ 25 ] . LiveEdit studies streaming editing with content-preservation constraints [ 18 ] ; a broader survey organizes controllable video conditioning mechanisms [ 9 ] . Holding the generator fixed across retrieval policies, we test whether reference relevance and historical resemblance predict current-story correctness.

paragraphs.en: VBench measures perceptual and semantic quality [ 6 ] . MovieBench, MSVBench, and EntityBench evaluate movie-level or cross-shot consistency [ 20 , 15 , 3 ] ; MBench and NarraStream-Bench test memory or narrative consistency [ 27 , 8 ] . SubjectAnchor combines subject-aware memory with a trained video model and its own storytelling benchmark, including shot-level inclusion/exclusion control [ 17 ] . Our two tracks measure selected evidence before generation and story correctness afterward, complementing these evaluations and SubjectAnchor’s inclusion/exclusion tests. This does not establish superiority over its trained architecture (Supplementary Table 12 ; App. C ).
paragraphs.zh: VBench 衡量感知与语义质量 [ 6 ] 。 MovieBench、MSVBench 和 EntityBench 评估电影级或跨镜头一致性 [ 20 , 15 , 3 ] ；MBench 和 NarraStream-Bench 测试记忆或叙事一致性 [ 27 , 8 ] 。 SubjectAnchor 将主体感知记忆与一个训练过的视频模型及其自有的叙事基准相结合，包括镜头级的包含/排除控制 [ 17 ] 。 我们的两条评估轨道分别在生成前测量所选证据、在生成后测量故事正确性，与这些评估以及 SubjectAnchor 的包含/排除测试形成互补。 这并不能证明其相对于该训练架构的优势（补充材料表 12 ；附录 C ）。

paragraphs.en: LongMemEval and MemoryAgentBench connect memory operations to task success [ 19 , 5 ] . RAGChecker already separates retrieval quality from generation quality and identifies distracting evidence [ 14 ] . Our question concerns temporal validity in visual generation: historical appearance continuity can coexist with an incorrect current state or an unwanted entity. We jointly test selected evidence, updated states, forbidden appearances, and prompt-information sensitivity. No-memory controls check what history adds beyond the current instruction, while complete-policy comparisons measure the outcome of each evolving memory history, with explicit limits on causal attribution.
paragraphs.zh: LongMemEval 与 MemoryAgentBench 将记忆操作与任务成功联系起来 [ 19 , 5 ] 。 RAGChecker 已经能够将检索质量与生成质量区分开来，并识别干扰性证据 [ 14 ] 。 我们关注的是视觉生成中的时间有效性：历史外观的连续性可能与不正确的当前状态或不需要的实体并存。 我们联合测试所选择的证据、更新后的状态、禁止出现的内容，以及对提示信息的敏感性。 无记忆对照组检验历史在当前指令之外增加了什么，而完整策略比较则衡量每条不断演化的记忆历史的结果，并对因果归因给出了明确的限制。

paragraphs.en: To study the utility of history, we observe two points in Eq. 1 : the references a policy selects before generation (Track-A) and the video produced afterward (Track-B). VMem-Bench is the experimental instrument for this investigation; Fig. 2 shows the two protocols. For example, Track-A asks whether selected references cover a puppy requested in a later segment of the real film Spring (Fig. 12 ). Track-B instead tests memory use in independently authored, generated stories, with no-memory and last-seen controls. The two tracks measure complementary boundaries, not matched instances.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究历史记录的效用，我们观察式 1 中的两点：策略在生成之前选择的参考（Track-A）以及之后生成的视频（Track-B）。 VMem-Bench 是这项研究的实验工具；图 2 展示了两种协议。 例如，Track-A 探讨所选参考是否涵盖了真实影片《春》（Spring）后续片段中出现的小狗（图 12）。 Track-B 则在独立创作的生成故事中测试记忆的使用，并设置了无记忆和最近可见两种对照条件。 这两条路线衡量的是互补的边界，而非匹配的实例。

paragraphs.en: Track-A measures the evidence handed to a generator, without running one; its instructions name the entities on screen. paragraphs.en: Track-A is built from BlenderOpenMovies and LSMDC (Table 2 ): 92 films, 16,548 segments, 44.91 hours, and 2,803 typed characters, props, and locations, with reappearance, multi-instance, scene-return, and state-change slices.
paragraphs.zh: Track-A 由 BlenderOpenMovies 和 LSMDC 构建（表 2）：92 部电影、16,548 个片段、44.91 小时，以及 2,803 个带类型的角色、道具和场景位置，并包含重现、多实例、场景回归和状态变化等切片。

paragraphs.en: Track-B contains 30 human-authored stories expanded into 2,824 five-second segments (3.92 hours), with reappearances up to 77 segments apart. The instruction gives an entity’s look only when it first appears or changes state; later prompts usually name the entity without repeating its full appearance. Many props, however, carry their look in the name (“the two brass fog bells”), and most returns after 30 or more segments are either such props or characters that come back changed, with the new look spelled out. Each segment is tagged with the memory stresses it exercises (Fig. 2 ): six ask the system to remember something and three to keep something out (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: Track-B 包含 30 个由人工创作的故事，扩展为 2,824 个五秒片段（3.92 小时），其中同一实体再次出现的间隔最多可达 77 个片段。 指令只会在实体首次出现或改变状态时给出其外观；后续提示通常只提及实体名称，而不重复其完整外观描述。 然而，许多道具的名称本身就带有外观信息（如“那两座黄铜雾钟”），而在间隔 30 个或更多片段后再次出现的实体，大多是这类道具，或是以变化后的状态回归且明确写出新外观的角色。 每个片段都标注了它所考察的记忆压力类型（图 2）：其中六类要求系统记住某些内容，三类要求系统排除某些内容（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: Track-A gold comes from a staged pipeline: VLM proposals are normalized by deterministic contracts and stronger-model review triggers targeted repair. Humans fix the canonical entity roster, and every blocked unit plus a stratified audit sample of the rest passes blocking human review before a deterministic freeze (App. B.1 ).

paragraphs.en: A pinned Qwen3-VL-32B judge, blind to system identity, checks each reference against the frozen roster and the real next segment. Both, and their F1, are computed per segment and averaged over a film’s segments, then over films (so the reported F1 is not the harmonic mean of the reported averages). paragraphs.en: The same judge sees each generated segment with a blinded list of entities that should appear, should not appear, look alike, or are decoys, each with its gold description, and marks which are present. An entity counts as present when the clip shows something that matches its description; the judge does not compare it with the entity’s earlier renderings, so a fresh, description-matching stranger scores as a hit. Track-B therefore also scores identity : whether a returning entity looks the same as its previous appearance in the same rollout, measured as the DINOv3 similarity of the localized entity over returns detected in both clips, with ArcFace for faces, MegaLoc for locations, and a pairwise VLM judge as a check; thresholds are calibrated on control pairs before any condition is scored (App. D.2 ). Counts are pooled over all segments. Recall ( R R ) is the fraction of required character and prop appearances that are present; Precision ( P P ) is the fraction of present characters and props that were required; F1 is their harmonic mean; Avoid-OK ( A A ) is the fraction of forbidden appearances that stay absent. Rather than collapse memory usefulness into a single consistency score, we examine the vector of policy-level differences to no memory:
paragraphs.zh: 同一个评审者会看到每个生成的片段，以及一份盲化的实体列表，其中包括应当出现、不应出现、外观相似或是干扰项的实体，每个实体都附有其标准描述，评审者需标记哪些实体出现了。 当片段中出现与实体描述相符的内容时，该实体即视为出现；评审者不会将其与该实体早先的渲染结果进行比较，因此一个全新的、符合描述的陌生对象也会被计为命中。 因此 Track-B 还会评估一致性：即重复出现的实体在同一 rollout 中是否与之前的外观保持一致，其衡量方式是对两段片段中均被检测到的重复出现的实体计算局部化区域的 DINOv3 相似度，人脸使用 ArcFace，场景使用 MegaLoc，并以成对 VLM 评审作为核查；在任何条件被评分之前，阈值均先在对照对上进行校准（附录 D.2）。 所有片段的计数会被汇总合并。 召回率（R R）是必需的角色和道具出现中被实际呈现的比例；精确率（P P）是实际呈现的角色和道具中属于必需的比例；F1 是二者的调和平均；Avoid-OK（A A）是禁止出现的角色和道具保持未出现的比例。 我们没有把记忆的有用性压缩成一个单一的一致性分数，而是考察相对于无记忆条件的策略层面差异向量：

paragraphs.en: We evaluate four retrieval policies. Text-frame ranks individual historical frames by text similarity; Seg+uniform retrieves text-matched segments and samples frames uniformly; Seg+DINO-key chooses visually diverse DINOv3 keyframes from retrieved segments; and Seg+frame re-ranks frames within the top text-retrieved segments. Track-A scores their selected references at a cap of B = 16 B{=}16 . Track-B uses K = 3 K{=}3 references from each condition’s own generated history . One shared generator combines FLUX.2 keyframe composition with Wan2.2-TI2V-5B five-second video generation. We compare against no memory (no historical references) and last-seen (the most recent generated appearance of each required entity, selected using gold entity IDs, but no gold pixels or descriptions). Last-seen is a privileged diagnostic control, not a deployable baseline or a bound on achievable performance. Results use one rollout per story and condition; paired story-clustered 95% CIs characterize variation across these 30 stories, conditional on those rollouts (App. D.1 ). Released systems form a separate native-generator block in Table 3 ; generator differences preclude memory-only comparisons (App. C ).

paragraphs.en: Our location results do not show a retrieval failure: over 425 returns, retrieval raises whole-frame MegaLoc similarity by + 0.15 +0.15 to + 0.21 +0.21 over no memory (Supplementary Table 18 ). This embedding measures scene similarity, not location correctness. Separately, viewpoint and layout changes can challenge appearance-only cross-view matching, a problem addressed with geometry cues in Group Editing [ 10 ] . Geometry-aware location memory is therefore an untested hypothesis, not an explanation supported by our results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的位置结果并未显示检索失败：在超过425次返回中，检索使整帧MegaLoc相似度比无记忆情况提升+0.15至+0.21（补充表18）。 这一嵌入衡量的是场景相似性，而非位置的正确性。 另外，视角和布局的变化可能会给仅基于外观的跨视角匹配带来挑战，Group Editing [10] 中通过几何线索解决了这一问题。 因此，几何感知的位置记忆是一个未经检验的假设，而非我们的结果所支持的解释。

paragraphs.en: The quality control scores all 2,824 clips per shared-generator condition with six VBench-style metrics [ 6 ] . No memory has higher subject and background consistency despite lower entity recall; Seg+DINO-key instead has higher imaging and aesthetic scores (Table 8 ). No quality metric correlates positively with per-clip entity recall above ρ = 0.17 \rho=0.17 in any condition. Within-clip stability can coexist with entity-level failures, so quality and entity correctness require separate reporting. This does not establish independence or eliminate all quality confounds.
paragraphs.zh: 质量控制对所有 2,824 个每个共享生成器条件下的剪辑使用六项 VBench 风格的指标 [ 6 ] 进行打分。 No Memory 尽管实体召回率较低，却拥有更高的主体一致性和背景一致性；而 Seg+DINO-key 则在成像和美学得分上更高（表 8）。 在任何条件下，没有任何质量指标与逐剪辑实体召回率呈 ρ = 0.17 \rho=0.17 以上的正相关。 剪辑内稳定性可以与实体层面的失败共存，因此质量与实体正确性需要分开报告。 这并不能证明独立性，也不能消除所有质量上的混杂因素。

paragraphs.en: The aggregate trade-off largely survives rescoring the same videos (Table 9 ). Both judges support recall gains and Avoid-OK losses for all four retrieval policies. paragraphs.en: More memory does not necessarily mean better videos. In our controlled study, retrieved history improves entity recall and resemblance to earlier appearances, yet can reintroduce retired entities and reinforce obsolete states. Detailed prompts can also make long-gap generation succeed without visual memory. The practical lesson is to assess three distinct questions: what information history adds , which temporal state is valid , and what unwanted content accompanies useful evidence . Report these alongside perceptual quality; recall or historical resemblance alone does not establish memory utility. VMem-Bench provides evidence- and generation-stage measurements, with an evaluation checklist in App. A . These are assessment principles, not a validated controller or a universal memory-capacity law.
paragraphs.zh: 更多的记忆并不一定意味着更好的视频。 在我们的对照研究中，检索到的历史能提升实体召回率以及与早期出场形象的相似度，但也可能重新引入已退场的实体并固化过时的状态。 详细的提示词也能使长间隔生成在没有视觉记忆的情况下成功。 实践中的经验是要评估三个不同的问题：历史增加了什么信息，哪个时间状态是有效的，以及有用的证据伴随了哪些不想要的内容。 应将这些指标与感知质量一起报告；仅凭召回率或历史相似度并不能证明记忆的效用。 VMem-Bench 提供了证据阶段和生成阶段的测量，并在附录 A 中给出了评估清单。 这些是评估原则，而非经过验证的控制器或普适的记忆容量定律。

paragraphs.en: The study identifies three questions that a memory evaluation should keep distinct: whether history supplies information beyond the current instruction and any baseline context, whether its appearance matches the requested temporal state, and whether useful references carry unwanted entities. These are measurement questions, not a sufficient decision rule for reading memory. For example, a prompt describing a blue coat may still omit the face; textual detail alone does not establish that visual history is redundant. Likewise, an older appearance can be correct for an explicit flashback: validity is relative to the instruction, not simply reference recency. Table 10 turns the findings into reporting actions.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究识别出记忆评估应当区分的三个问题：历史是否提供了超出当前指令和任何基线上下文的信息，其出现是否与所要求的时序状态相匹配，以及有用的引用是否携带了不需要的实体。 这些是测量层面的问题，而非读取记忆的充分决策规则。 例如，一个描述蓝色外套的提示词仍可能遗漏面部；仅凭文本细节并不能证明视觉历史是冗余的。 同样，较旧的外观对于明确的闪回场景可能是正确的：有效性取决于指令本身，而不是简单地取决于引用的新旧程度。 表 10 将这些发现转化为可执行的报告行动。

paragraphs.en: Track-A gold is built in four stages followed by a deterministic freeze. Model outputs are replaceable proposals; stable identifiers, prompt completeness, and frozen gold are fixed by deterministic contracts and human adjudication. S1 drafts bounded segments, present entities, first appearances, and finite-ontology state events; a human-confirmed canonical roster is the naming authority. S3 reviews each segment with Qwen3-VL-8B [ 13 ] ; low-confidence/conflicting presence claims are rechecked and confirmed entities trigger deterministic prompt repair. Each unit receives Pass , Warn , Block , or RetryableError . S4 sends every Block plus a stratified audit sample of the remaining units to blocking human review. Accepted decisions re-run the full deterministic validator. The final freeze writes the gold registry and layout hash; a changed layout/exclusion set creates a new data version. Every stage writes a derived artifact and never mutates the original draft. Fig. More Memory, Better Videos? paragraphs.en: Table 11 summarizes only the 30 evaluated stories, not the larger authoring pool. paragraphs.en: Table 12 compares the reported designs and measurements of OneStory, StoryMem, and SubjectAnchor with our study. They develop trained memory-conditioned generators and evaluate narrative quality, alignment, or identity. SubjectAnchor also explicitly studies shot-level inclusion/exclusion, so entity exclusion itself is not our novelty. Our diagnostic emphasis is the validity of selected historical evidence for the current state, its interaction with prompt information, and the distinction between reference quality and whole-policy outcomes. paragraphs.en: Released causal systems are driven through authors’ released memory mechanisms and weights with only protocol-required substitutions; the four retrieval memories are ours and form the controlled testbed. All scored rows share frozen gold, causal guard, materialization, and scoring. No gold crop or gold identity is exposed to an ordinary system; only the privileged last-seen control uses gold IDs for reference selection (App. C.4 ). On Track-A, self-generated observation is replaced by the revealed real segment; if a native write requires a model forward, we use one teacher-forced clean-context forward without denoising. Recalled items are mapped back to source frames through temporal identities and dropped if they violate the causal guard. Methods that require future story information or modalities absent from passive film are not assigned surrogate quantitative scores. Table 13 summarizes why the families’ internal diagnostics are not comparable and which common observables VMem-Bench uses.

paragraphs.en: All six shared-generator conditions (the four retrieval memories and the two controls) come from one run of the released testbed ( vmem_bench.testbed , seed 2026): one rollout per story and condition, all generated with the same code revision and scored by the same judge. Each story starts with an empty retrieval store and an empty entity bank. At segment n n , the authored prompt g n g_{n} is used directly as the retrieval query. The history record for each prior segment stores that same authored prompt as both prompt text and description, together with frames decoded from that memory’s own previously generated MP4; no real-film frame, gold crop, or other memory’s trajectory enters the archive. Retrieval happens before write-back, with eligibility requiring the historical segment end time to be no later than the store clock. The resulting still images are then passed as composed references to a shared keyframe-first stack: FLUX.2 Klein 9B-KV FP8 composes either a text-only or multi-reference keyframe, and Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo expands it to a 121-frame segment (1280 × \times 704 render, delivered at 832 × \times 480). The generated segment is then appended to that memory’s own store and becomes available to later segments. The retrieval reference budget is K = 3 K{=}3 ; the audited code defaults are 1-fps uniform sampling, 2-fps dense sampling, top-5 text-ranked segments, three DINO keyframes per segment, and reciprocal-rank fusion with k = 60 k{=}60 for Seg+frame reranking. The scorer is the same pinned Qwen3-VL-32B judge used for every Track-B row, applied to the frozen story gold.
paragraphs.zh: 全部六个共享生成器条件（四个检索记忆和两个对照组）均来自已发布测试台（ vmem_bench.testbed ，种子 2026）的单次运行：每个故事和每个条件各一次 rollout，全部由同一代码修订版生成，并由同一评判者打分。 每个故事都以空的检索库和空的实体库开始。 在第 n 个片段 n n ，编写的提示词 g n g_{n} 被直接用作检索查询。 每个先前片段的历史记录将同一编写的提示词同时存储为提示词文本和描述，并连同从该记忆自身先前生成的 MP4 中解码出的帧一起存储；任何真实影片帧、黄金裁剪或其他记忆的轨迹都不会进入存档。 检索发生在写回之前，资格要求历史片段的结束时间不晚于库时钟。 生成的静态图像随后作为组合参考传入共享的以关键帧优先的流水线：FLUX.2 Klein 9B-KV FP8 合成纯文本或多参考关键帧，Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo 将其扩展为 121 帧的片段（1280 × \times 704 渲染，以 832 × \times 480 交付）。 生成的片段随后被追加到该记忆自身的库中，并对后续片段可用。 检索参考预算为 K = 3 K{=}3 ；经审计的代码默认设置为 1-fps 均匀采样、2-fps 密集采样、按文本排名前 5 的片段、每片段三个 DINO 关键帧，以及用于 Seg+frame 重排序的倒数排名融合（ k = 60 k{=}60 ）。 打分器与用于每个 Track-B 行的固定 Qwen3-VL-32B 评判者相同，应用于冻结的故事黄金标准。

paragraphs.en: The reported retrieval rollouts are keyframe-first: selected stills are composed into a single FLUX scene keyframe, and Wan receives that image as its first-frame condition. This is useful for holding a simple realization mechanism fixed, but it introduces a structural bias: memory that should emerge only later in the segment may be pulled into the first frame. The codebase also contains Wan2.2-I2V-A14B backends with SVI/Morphic LoRA variants, but the reported Track-B retrieval rows did not use those paths; they used Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo. A unified multimodal reference-conditioned generator such as MiniMax H3 [ 12 ] , which accepts text, image, video, and audio context directly, is a natural future replacement because it may avoid collapsing multiple memory cues into one forced first-frame keyframe. When we designed the Track-B realization setup, H3 had not yet been open-sourced; the main results therefore use the FLUX-to-Wan scaffold. We have since run all six conditions on 8 stories with two H3 realizations (App. F.6 , Table 22 ); we make no claim that H3 improves VMem-Bench scores.
paragraphs.zh: 所报告的检索式生成流程采用关键帧优先的方式：选定的静帧被合成为单一的 FLUX 场景关键帧，Wan 则接收该图像作为其首帧条件。 这有助于将一种简单的具象化机制固定下来，但它引入了一种结构性偏差：本应在片段后期才出现的记忆可能被拉入首帧。 代码库中还包含带 SVI/Morphic LoRA 变体的 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 后端，但所报告的 Track-B 检索行并未使用这些路径；它们使用的是 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo。 像 MiniMax H3 [ 12 ] 这样直接接受文本、图像、视频和音频上下文的统一多模态参考条件生成器是未来自然的替代方案，因为它可以避免将多个记忆线索强行压缩为一个首帧关键帧。 当我们设计 Track-B 的具象化设置时，H3 尚未开源；因此主要结果使用的是 FLUX 到 Wan 的流程。 此后，我们在 8 个故事上用两种 H3 具象化方式运行了全部六种条件（附录 F.6，表 22）；我们并不声称 H3 能提升 VMem-Bench 的分数。

paragraphs.en: For Track-B segment n n , the control reads the gold cast and keeps the characters and props that must appear and have appeared before. It orders them by gap (longest first), keeps up to three, and for each takes the middle frame of this rollout’s own clip of the segment in which the entity last appeared; duplicates are merged. The generator receives only these frames, never gold text, names, or images, and a guard admits only clips that this run produced strictly before segment n n . Because the needed entity was usually on screen just before, 1,803 segments receive one reference, 842 two, 149 three, and 30 (the first segment of each story) none. The control shows what a memory gains by choosing the right entity at its latest moment; it is not an information upper bound, since it hands over fewer references than retrieval and its frame may itself be a wrong earlier rendering.
paragraphs.zh: 对于轨道 B（Track-B）的分段 n n，控制器读取金标准演员表，并保留必须出现且此前已出现过的角色和道具。 控制器按间隔时间对它们排序（最长者优先），最多保留三个，并为每个实体取该实体上次出现的分段在本次 rollout 自身片段中的中间帧；重复的会被合并。 生成器只接收这些帧，绝不会接收金标准文本、名称或图像，并且一个防护机制只允许本运行严格在分段 n n 之前生成的片段通过。 由于所需实体通常刚好在之前出现在画面上，1,803 个分段获得一个参考，842 个获得两个，149 个获得三个，30 个（每个故事的首个分段）没有参考。 该控制展示了记忆通过在实体最近出现的时刻选择正确实体所能获得的收益；它并非信息上界，因为它传递的参考数量少于检索，且其帧本身可能是此前一次错误的渲染。

paragraphs.en: MemFlow [ 7 ] combines a recent window with a compressed long-term KV bank. We teacher-force each revealed Track-A segment through the released base+LoRA clean-context commit path, record the local window and surviving bank blocks, and recover source frames via bit-exact fingerprints of retained KV blocks. The temporal RoPE table is extended to the film length with the same closed-form rotary embedding. Track-B uses the released generator-coupled path.
paragraphs.zh: MemFlow [7] 将近期窗口与压缩的长期 KV 库相结合。 我们通过已发布的 base+LoRA 干净上下文提交路径，对每个已揭示的 Track-A 片段进行教师强制，记录局部窗口与存活的库块，并通过对保留 KV 块的逐位精确指纹恢复源帧。 时间维度的 RoPE 表通过相同的闭式旋转位置编码扩展至胶片长度。 Track-B 使用已发布的与生成器耦合的路径。

paragraphs.en: IAMFlow [ 8 ] scores frames using the native diffusion transformer’s KV cache. Its offline driver precomputes entities from the full prompt list; our causal adapter disables this future look-ahead and uses native per-prompt processing. Track-B uses the released generator-coupled stack. Track-A is reported only as a scalability diagnostic because the native per-frame KV archive exceeds host memory on long films.
paragraphs.zh: IAMFlow [8] 利用原生扩散 Transformer 的 KV 缓存对帧进行评分。 其离线驱动器会从完整的提示词列表中预先计算实体；我们的因果适配器禁用了这种未来前瞻，并使用原生的逐提示词处理。 Track-B 使用已发布的与生成器耦合的堆栈。 Track-A 仅作为可扩展性诊断报告，因为在长影片上原生逐帧 KV 存档会超出主机内存。

paragraphs.en: IAMFlow’s native long-term archive copies per-frame K/V slices to host memory. For its Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, one archived frame costs approximately 30 × 2 × 1560 × 1536 × 2 30\times 2\times 1560\times 1536\times 2 bytes ≈ 274 \approx 274 MiB. In our driver, 15-second segments add about 5.3 GiB of anonymous host memory per segment; with an 800–900 GiB host-memory budget, the native carrier reaches a hard horizon of roughly three thousand archived KV frames.
paragraphs.zh: IAMFlow 的原生长期归档机制会将每帧的 K/V 切片复制到主机内存。 以其 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 骨干网络为例，归档一帧大约需要 30 × 2 × 1560 × 1536 × 2 30\times 2\times 1560\times 1536\times 2 字节 ≈ 274 \approx 274 MiB。 在我们的驱动程序中，15 秒的片段每个会新增约 5.3 GiB 的匿名主机内存；在 800–900 GiB 的主机内存预算下，原生载体在大约三千个归档 KV 帧处达到硬性上限。

paragraphs.en: Every difference between a retrieval memory and the no-memory control is given with a paired, story-clustered bootstrap: the 30 stories are resampled with replacement 2,000 times (seed 20260925), the same draw is applied to both conditions, and counts are pooled within the draw before taking the rate. paragraphs.en: For each appearance, three frames (15, 50, and 85% of the clip) side by side. The judge receives both strips, the entity’s name, kind, and gold description at each appearance (with a note when a state change is expected), is told to ignore camera, pose, lighting, and background, and answers in JSON whether the entity is visible in each strip and, if in both, whether it is the same individual (face, hair, build, clothing; shape, color, material, markings for props). The condition is hidden. The scorer also reports the share of units where the entity is visible in both clips and judged the same, but this rate depends on how well the previous appearance was rendered, which memory affects through the earlier segments of the rollout: for characters returning changed after 30 or more segments, the current clip shows the character in almost every condition ( 0.98 0.98 – 1.00 1.00 ) and visible pairs are almost always called the same ( 0.93 0.93 – 1.00 1.00 ), so nearly the whole difference between conditions ( 0.10 0.10 vs. 0.46 0.46 – 0.57 0.57 ) comes from the old appearance. We therefore report the same-individual rate among returns visible in both clips, which compares the two appearances only.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每次出场，并排展示三帧（片段的 15%、50% 和 85% 处）。 评判者会收到两条条带，以及实体在每次出场时的名称、类别和标准描述（在预期发生状态变化时会有说明），并被要求忽略镜头、姿势、光照和背景，然后以 JSON 形式回答实体是否在每条条带中可见，如果两条中都可见，则回答是否为同一个体（角色看面部、发型、体型、衣着；道具看形状、颜色、材质、标记）。评判条件是隐藏的。 评分器还会报告实体在两个片段中均可见且被判定为相同的单元占比，但这一比率取决于前一次出场被渲染得多好，而记忆是通过 rollout 的较早片段来影响这一点的：对于间隔 30 个或更多片段后以变化状态回归的角色，当前片段在几乎所有条件下都会显示该角色（0.98–1.00），且可见配对几乎总是被判定为相同（0.93–1.00），因此条件之间的几乎所有差异（0.10 对比 0.46–0.57）都来自旧的外观。 因此，我们报告在两个片段中均可见的回归角色中的同个体率，该指标仅比较两次外观。

paragraphs.en: GroundingDINO localizes the entity in each frame from its name and description; the crop is embedded with DINOv3 and, for characters, the largest face in the crop with ArcFace. Locations use the whole frame through MegaLoc, a place-recognition model, with whole-frame DINOv3 as a secondary check; whole-frame similarity is not used for characters or props, since a memory that copies a reference’s composition would score high without the entity being the same. The similarity of a unit is the highest cosine over frame pairs detected on both sides; we report its mean over units detected on both sides.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingDINO 根据名称和描述在每个帧中定位该实体；裁剪区域用 DINOv3 嵌入，对于角色，还用 ArcFace 对裁剪区域中最大的人脸进行嵌入。 对于地点，使用 MegaLoc（一个地点识别模型）处理整帧，并以整帧 DINOv3 作为二次校验；整帧相似度不用于角色或道具，因为一段记忆若只是复制了参考片段的构图，即使实体并非同一对象也会得到高分。 一个单元的相似度取其在两侧均被检测到的帧对上的最高余弦值；我们报告在两侧均被检测到的单元上的均值。

sents.en: Locations use the whole frame through MegaLoc, a place-recognition model, with whole-frame DINOv3 as a secondary check; whole-frame similarity is not used for characters or props, since a memory that copies a reference’s composition would score high without the entity being the same.

paragraphs.en: Positive controls pair two disjoint frame sets of one clip; negative controls pair two different entities of the same kind and story (Table 16 ). The embeddings separate them almost perfectly, the VLM judge less so: it rarely calls two visible look-alikes different, so its same-individual rate is optimistic. DINOv3 crop similarity is therefore the primary identity measure and the VLM judge a check. Three frames can miss a brief appearance. Differences to no memory use the same paired story bootstrap as all Track-B results (Table 18 ).
paragraphs.zh: 正对照对将同一视频片段的两个不相交帧集合配对；负对照对将同一类别且同一故事的两个不同实体配对（表 16）。 嵌入向量几乎能完美区分它们，而 VLM 判别器的区分能力较弱：它很少将两个可见的相似个体判定为不同，因此其同一个体率偏乐观。 因此 DINOv3 裁剪相似度是主要的身份度量，VLM 判别器仅作为校验。 三帧可能会错过短暂的出现。 与不使用记忆的差异采用与所有 Track-B 结果相同的成对故事自助法（表 18）。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 15 shows why a recall-versus-gap curve misleads: every condition, including no memory, recalls more at long gaps, because a returning entity is named in the instruction and, after a long absence, usually described (Table 17 ); paired differences to no memory assess the added benefit of each complete policy.

paragraphs.en: VMem-Bench measures memory, not visual quality; this control asks whether per-clip quality could explain the memory differences within the shared-generator testbed. Every one of the 2,824 Track-B clips of each condition is scored with VBench 0.1.5’s own models and formulas [ 6 ] : imaging quality (MUSIQ), aesthetic quality (LAION head on CLIP ViT-L/14), subject consistency (DINO), background consistency (CLIP), dynamic degree (RAFT), and motion smoothness (AMT). Image metrics use eight fixed frames per clip; runs are deterministic. Table 19 reports means with story-clustered bootstrap 95% CIs and the mean per-clip entity recall of the same clips. Across the four retrieval memories the largest standardized difference in any quality metric is 0.27 0.27 , and no metric correlates with per-clip recall above ρ = 0.17 \rho{=}0.17 in any condition. The no-memory control has lower recall but higher subject and background consistency (standardized differences 0.18 0.18 – 0.45 0.45 ): these metrics reward within-clip stability, which a rollout that never recalls earlier evidence can achieve. Released systems are omitted because they use different generators.
paragraphs.zh: VMem-Bench 度量的是记忆能力而非视觉质量；本对照实验旨在检验在共享生成器的测试平台中，逐片段的质量差异是否可能解释记忆能力的差异。 每种条件的 2,824 条 Track-B 片段中的每一条都使用 VBench 0.1.5 自带的模型和公式 [6] 进行评分：成像质量（MUSIQ）、美学质量（LAION head 基于 CLIP ViT-L/14）、主体一致性（DINO）、背景一致性（CLIP）、动态程度（RAFT）和运动平滑度（AMT）。 图像指标使用每个片段的八个固定帧；运行过程是确定性的。 表 19 报告了均值及基于故事聚类 bootstrap 的 95% 置信区间，以及同一批片段的逐片段实体召回率均值。 在四种检索记忆之间，任何质量指标的最大标准化差异为 0.27 0.27，且在任何条件下，没有任何指标与逐片段召回率的相关性超过 ρ = 0.17 \rho{=}0.17。 无记忆对照条件的召回率较低，但主体一致性和背景一致性较高（标准化差异为 0.18 0.18 – 0.45 0.45）：这些指标奖励片段内的稳定性，而从不召回早期证据的生成过程恰恰可以实现这种稳定性。 已发布的系统因使用不同的生成器而被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: Table 20 repeats the comparisons with no memory on segments whose judge output parsed in both arms, since an unparsable output counts every required entity as missed and retrieval produces more of them (91–115 segments against 55 for no memory and 79 for last-seen references). All main effects stay: gains at 1–4 segments and for persistent states, no presence gain at 30 or more segments, and lower precision and avoidance. Between 5 and 29 segments the three segment memories also gain significantly ( + 0.05 +0.05 ), which the full data leaves uncertain. The second part splits the last-seen control by how many references it used. Both costs grow with count, but these are unmatched segment groups: the association does not isolate a reference-count effect. At two references, last-seen’s measured costs are about half those of retrieval on its different, three-reference sample.
paragraphs.zh: 表20在两个分支中评判输出均可解析的分段上重复了无记忆条件的比较，因为不可解析的输出会把所有必需实体都计为遗漏，而检索会产生更多此类输出（91–115个分段，相比之下无记忆为55个，最近引用为79个）。 所有主要效应依然成立：在1–4个分段和持久状态下有收益，在30个及以上分段时没有在场性收益，以及精确率和回避率更低。 在5到29个分段之间，三种分段记忆也有显著收益（+0.05），而完整数据对此并不确定。 第二部分按最近引用这一对照条件使用了多少引用来对其进行拆分。 两种成本都随数量增长，但这些是未匹配的分段组：这种关联无法分离出引用数量的效应。 在两个引用的情况下，最近引用所测得的成本大约只有检索在其不同的三引用样本上成本的一半。

paragraphs.en: Table 21 rescores the same videos with InternVL3.5-30B-A3B, a judge from another model family, given the same roster, prompt, and clip (16 frames). It calls an entity present far less often in every condition (no-memory recall 0.361 0.361 against 0.559 0.559 ). The two judges give the same verdict on 88 % 88\% of roster entries in every memory condition and on 91 % 91\% without memory, where fewer entities are on screen ( κ \kappa 0.62 0.62 – 0.67 0.67 ), so their disagreement is not concentrated in any arm. Under the second judge every memory’s recall gain keeps its size ( + 0.060 +0.060 to + 0.128 +0.128 , every CI above zero), and the costs of similarity retrieval keep their sign at about half the size (Avoid-OK − 0.015 -0.015 to − 0.054 -0.054 , every CI below zero; precision − 0.008 -0.008 to − 0.032 -0.032 , three of four below zero), while the smaller costs of last-seen references vanish. The per-stress effects are less stable: the gains for persistent states, the losses for indirect references and false friends, and the last-seen loss for time references are not significant under the second judge, so they rest on the pinned judge alone.

paragraphs.en: From the frozen judge’s per-entity verdicts we form four unit types: a required recall entity absent from the judge’s present set ( miss ; stratified by absence gap 1–4, 5–29, ≥ \geq 30, and temporal reference), an entity present in a wrong persisted state (a state already shown earlier, so memory could supply it) or as the wrong look-alike member ( wrong ), a destroyed or deceased entity rendered ( forbidden ), and a required entity the judge found ( control ). Each retrieval memory contributes 56 units (28 miss, 10 wrong, 10 forbidden, 8 control; Table 24 ) drawn with seed 20260925; 10% of units reappear later as hidden repeats, and five unscored practice items come first. Segments without recorded references or keyframe are excluded before sampling. The manifest, media hashes, and inclusion probabilities were written before any label was collected.

sents.en: Judge misses concentrate in long-gap (17 of 32) and temporal-reference (9 of 14) failures, so Track-B recall in these families is conservative for the retrieval memories; the study did not sample the no-memory control, whose parse-failure rate is also lower (App. D.1 ).

paragraphs.en: Each policy writes its own history, so Track-B compares complete policies. Reference-count strata are also unmatched. To isolate a reference’s effect, branch from the same story prefix and generator state, fix the prompt, seed, and reference count, then replace one reference with a current-state, stale-state, or distractor-filtered alternative. Score required appearances, requested-state fidelity, and forbidden entities separately, so any reduction in interference is read alongside lost useful context. Use the instruction-valid state, including an older state for an explicit flashback. These interventions remain future work; pairing seeds alone would not identify a single-reference effect once histories diverge.

paragraphs.en: The 224-unit single-author audit uses an earlier shared-generator rollout. Among sampled, judge-flagged required-entity misses, inclusion-weighted shares are 29% writing, 36% selection, 7% synthesis, and 27% judge misses (App. G ). These conditional shares are not population failure frequencies. They motivate tests of necessity (information absent from prompt and recent context), temporal validity (the state requested now, including deliberate flashbacks), and non-interference (unrequested content in useful frames). Table 25 pairs each hypothesis with a result that would count against it. A failed gate or filter would not erase the measured prompt confound or recall/exclusion trade-off; it would show that this particular remedy does not resolve the measurement problem.
paragraphs.zh: 这项包含 224 个单元的单作者审计使用了早期的共享生成器 rollout。 在抽样得到、被裁判标记为缺失必需实体的案例中，按包含权重计算的份额为：写作 29%、选择 36%、综合 7%、裁判误判 27%（附录 G）。 这些条件份额并非总体失败频率。 它们启发了必要性测试（提示词与近期上下文中缺失的信息）、时间有效性测试（当前所请求的状态，包括刻意的闪回）以及不干扰性测试（有用画面中的未被请求内容）。 表 25 将每个假设与一项可被视为反证的结果配对。 某个门槛或过滤器失效并不会消除已测得的提示词混淆或召回/排除权衡；它只会表明这一特定补救措施并不能解决该测量问题。

paragraphs.en: All primary Track-B conditions use one generator, prompt stream, and scorer, but they generate distinct intermediate histories. Thus differences estimate the effects of complete retrieval policies on these authored stories, not the isolated causal effect of swapping a frame at one fixed generation state. Four retrieval policies use K = 3 K{=}3 references; the gold-ID last-seen control uses variable numbers of references and should not be interpreted as a matched-budget upper bound. There is one rollout per story and condition, so story-clustered confidence intervals do not measure sampling across generation seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 所有主要的 Track-B 条件都使用同一个生成器、提示流和评分器，但它们会产生不同的中间历史。 因此，差异估计的是完整检索策略对这些人工撰写故事的影响，而不是在某个固定生成状态下替换一个框架的孤立因果效应。 四种检索策略使用 K = 3 K{=}3 个参考；gold-ID last-seen 对照使用数量不等的参考，不应被解释为匹配预算下的上限。 每个故事和条件只有一次生成，因此按故事聚类的置信区间并未衡量跨生成种子的抽样。

paragraphs.en: The pinned Qwen3-VL judge can miss entities or conflate appearance with identity. A second, independent judge preserves the main aggregate directions but changes absolute rates and some fine-grained significance conclusions (App. F.6.2 ). Identity similarities are conditional on visible/detected returns and can reward an old appearance that violates the current state. Failure attribution uses one author’s stratified inspection of an earlier rollout and does not yield a population-level causal partition of all failure modes.
paragraphs.zh: 固定的 Qwen3-VL 判别智能体可能遗漏实体，或把外观与身份混为一谈。 第二个独立的判别智能体能保持总体聚合方向不变，但会改变绝对比率以及一些细粒度的显著性结论（附录 F.6.2）。 身份相似性以可见/检测到的返回结果为条件，可能奖励违反当前状态的旧外观。 失败归因基于一位作者对早期 rollout 的分层检查，并不能给出所有失败模式的总体层面的因果划分。

paragraphs.en: Track-B uses 30 authored, entity-labeled stories and a shared keyframe-plus-video pipeline; the alternative video-backend check covers eight stories. Track-A uses two real-film datasets but does not test downstream generation on those exact segments. Our title asks whether providing historical memory helps; we have not established how performance varies monotonically with storage capacity, reference count, or every type of state-aware memory architecture. The results should not be generalized to all genres, interactive policies, or models without further evidence.
paragraphs.zh: Track-B 使用 30 个人工撰写、带实体标注的故事，以及共享的关键帧加视频流水线；替代视频后端的检验覆盖八个故事。 Track-A 使用两个真实电影数据集，但没有在这些确切片段上测试下游生成。 我们的标题提出的问题是提供历史记忆是否有帮助；我们并未确定性能如何随存储容量、参考数量或每一类状态感知记忆架构单调变化。 在没有进一步证据的情况下，结果不应推广到所有题材、交互策略或模型。

paragraphs.en: Table 25 proposes tests, not established remedies. Prompt stripping does not validate a reading gate, and whole-rollout avoidance losses do not validate content filtering. Each proposal requires its own matched intervention and can fail while the measurement distinctions remain useful. Broader generators, seed variation, and interactive stories remain outside the demonstrated scope.
paragraphs.zh: 表25提出的是测试方案，而非已确立的补救措施。 去除提示词不能验证阅读门控，整个智能体流程的回避损失也不能验证内容过滤。 每项提案都需要其自身匹配的干预措施，即便测量上的区分仍有用处，该干预也可能失败。 更广泛的生成器、种子变化以及交互式故事仍超出了已验证的范围。
